quotedTweet.text:
shout out to everyone who read this quoted tweet, said "that's a good idea," and never acted on it

the loathsome Bookmark Guy archetype

all men are Bookmark Guy at times

however, that makes it no less vile

flaccid slug behavior, a contemptible toad, living Teddy Roosevelt's "Life of slothful ease"

in the words of Seneca's Letter LXXXII, "I hold that he who lies on a perfumed couch is no less dead than he who is dragged along by the executioner’s hook."

and in the words of the Bard: "A coward will bookmark 1,000 tweets before his death; the valiant will short wheat just to see how it feels."
